summary: Busy through road kerb with no parking and a house 7 m away.
reasons: Main road, no parked cars along kerb
Narrow kerb against fence, no pull-off

best_section.where: south kerb of Stanley Terrace opposite the bend, beside the pool house

drivers.seclusion: House 7 m away at 19 m; further homes close on the same side.
drivers.access_and_room: Ground beside the kerb is a narrow strip against fences and a retaining bank; no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Multi-lane through road with a school zone crossing; constant traffic.
drivers.convention: No cars parked on this kerb in either image; sign 2P Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted.

sun_shade: Open to sun, with tree shade from the south near the pool house.
